title: 龙国篇 第三十四章 极限瞬闪二龙国篇 第三十三章 极限瞬闪一
content_zh:
“武神斗铠，不动如山；动如闪，闪如光，难知如阴；王者之姿，至尊万古，王者之威”
“开”……
刹那间，数不尽的金色光芒迅速汇聚于叶恒的外衣之上，并在转瞬之间转化成一副坚硬无比的铠甲！这副铠甲一经现世，立刻引发天地异象。此时此刻，悬浮于半空之中的叶恒，全身上下的铠甲闪耀着璀璨夺目的金色光芒，宛如神明降临凡间一般，成为了黑暗中最为耀眼夺目的光芒。
尤其是武神之力化为铠甲后的“烈阳”，更是散发出令人不敢直视的耀眼光芒。
他轻轻地活动了一下身体，惊喜地察觉到自己的身躯变得比以往任何时候都要轻盈许多。尽管瞬间移动和战斗时的动作变得更为轻松自如，但需要注意的是，现在的他所施展的武神之力化铠乃是s级武神的觉醒技能。这种超越常规的提前使用方式，无疑会导致力量的消耗速度比平时快两倍以上。然而，这丝毫不会对他目前的行动造成任何阻碍。
他开始了第一次瞬闪，果然不出意外第一次瞬闪十分顺利，刚好停在了一栋破烂的房子处。
叶恒擦拭着额头的大汗，显然这一次极限瞬闪是真消耗了大半的武神力，他盘膝下坐进入冥想：“这来的一路上，我观察了很久也清晰他深吸一口气，然后猛地启动了第一次瞬闪。眨眼之间，他的身影便出现在了一栋破旧不堪的房子前。果然如他所料，第一次瞬闪非常顺利，仿佛一切都在掌握之中。
叶恒伸手擦去额头上豆大的汗珠，他的呼吸有些急促。刚才那一瞬间的极限瞬闪几乎耗尽了他大半的武神力，但他并没有停歇下来。他双腿一盘，席地而坐，闭上眼睛进入了冥想状态。
在冥想中，他仔细回忆起一路上的所见所闻。他清楚地记得，周围30公里范围内并没有斜坡等复杂的地形。这让他心中有了底，接下来的计划也逐渐明朗起来。
当冥想结束时，叶恒睁开双眼，眼中闪烁着坚定的光芒。他决定取消武神斗铠，再次施展极限瞬闪两次。只要能够成功离开龙爪市，后面的事情就会变得容易许多。
他站起身来，调整好气息，准备迎接下一轮的挑战。他知道，这两次极限瞬闪将是关键，也是他能否脱离困境的重要一步。
他深呼吸一下，在心中默默给自己加油鼓劲之后，再次发动了瞬闪，他清楚记得这来的一路上，甚至直线100公里外都没有斜坡等复杂的地形，所以这一次冥想后，他可以取消武神斗铠进行瞬闪，则这一次瞬闪后再接一次冥想的瞬闪就能完完全全的离开神龙市，等离开了神龙市一切都好说了，但……那是真的吗？
经过了七次极限瞬闪之后，叶恒的身体已经到了崩溃的边缘，他感觉自己仿佛要被撕裂一般。在这一连串的瞬移之中，他先是穿越了神龙市，然后来到了龙爪市。而这龙爪市更是以山地众多而闻名，叶恒足足闪烁了三次才成功离开这个城市。
不过，一旦越过了龙爪市，后面的路程就相对轻松多了。因为接下来的龙腹市和神龙市一样，都是一望无际的平原地带。
然而，现在身处龙腹市的叶恒却感到一阵恐慌。原来，龙腹市是龙国直径最大、面积最广阔的市区，其面积竟然高达166万平方公里！面对如此庞大的天文数字般的面积市区，叶恒不禁冷汗直流。
即使他拼尽全力，能够一息之间连续施展20次极限瞬闪，也无法逃离这座巨大的城市。他的心中充满了绝望，不知道该如何才能走出这片广袤无垠的土地。
叶恒心中暗自思忖：“若是我能够遁入虚空之门，便可在瞬息之间回到武神国。”然而，他随即又意识到，遁入虚空乃是ss武神的独门绝技，以自己a级武神的实力，这无疑是异想天开。
“看来到逃出这个龙腹市，没有十天时间怕是难以做到了……”正当叶恒感到茫然无措并几近昏厥之际，艾希和艾希竟突然从妙玉壶中跳了出来。
艾希望着眼前脸色苍白的叶恒，心中充满了无尽的怜爱和疼惜。她没有丝毫犹豫，立刻调动起自己强大的武神力，源源不断地注入到叶恒的体内，同时焦急地喊道：“你一定要撑住啊！绝对不能死！”
叶恒微微一笑，试图让艾希放心：“放心吧，我死不了，只是有些虚弱罢了，休息两个小时就能恢复过来。”

艾咪皱紧眉头，忧心忡忡地说：“可是看起来情况并不乐观，这次遇到的强敌实在太强大了，我们可能无法逃避。”
叶恒深吸一口气，眼中闪过一丝坚定：“嗯，既然如此，那我们就必须去勇敢面对。”
艾米点了点头，表示赞同：“好，那我现在就给总部发送我们的位置和相关信息。”
她拿出通讯器，迅速编辑了一条消息：“神器现世，引来各方强者争夺。我等虽奋勇夺得，但终因实力不济，身负重伤，现于此地疗养生息。望总部速速派援。”随着手指轻触发送键，这条关键的信息便飞向了远方。
（总部处……）
武神国的天空逐渐变得阴沉黑暗，浓密的乌云遮蔽了天空，倾盆而下的黄豆大雨纷纷落下。
丽莎静静地站在原地，目光投向远方，那个地方便是叶恒目前所在之处——龙国。
"现如今神器降世，世间恐怕又会陷入混乱之中。虽然五国表面上形成了统一战线，一起共同对抗异能兽，但实际上每个人都心怀鬼胎、勾心斗角。如果有一方能够得到神器，那就如同拥有了一件无敌的战争利器，战异能兽时不惧半色，同时又可以稳固自己国家的地位和实力。"
"就像凯王那样身为sss级武神，他本身就已经非常强大，又加上掌握着神器空之轨迹，曾经就仅凭一己之力与五国抗衡，最后毫不逊色。"
"而那场战斗更让他声名远扬，最终登上了世界最强五人之一的宝座，也被尊称为狂王。"
content_en:
"The battle armor of the God of War is as motionless as a mountain; it moves like flashes, flashes like light, and is as elusive as darkness; the posture of a king is supreme and eternal, and the majesty of a king"
"Open"...
In an instant, countless golden rays of light quickly gathered on Ye Heng's coat, and transformed into a pair of extremely hard armor in an instant! Once this armor appeared, it immediately caused strange phenomena in the world. At this moment, Ye Heng was suspended in mid-air, and the armor all over his body shone with dazzling golden light, as if a god had descended into the mortal world, becoming the most dazzling light in the darkness.
In particular, the "blazing sun" after the power of the God of War is transformed into armor emits a dazzling light that makes people dare not look directly at it.
He moved his body slightly and was pleasantly surprised to find that his body had become much lighter than before. Although teleportation and combat movements have become more relaxed, it should be noted that the armor he is currently using is the awakening skill of the S-class Martial God. This way of using it in advance beyond the normal will undoubtedly cause the power to be consumed more than twice as fast as usual. However, this will not hinder his current actions in any way.
He started his first flash. As expected, the first flash went smoothly and he happened to stop at a dilapidated house.
Ye Heng wiped the sweat from his forehead. It was obvious that this extreme flash had really consumed most of his martial arts power. He sat cross-legged and meditated: "On the way here, I observed it for a long time and it became clear. He took a deep breath, and then suddenly started the first flash. In the blink of an eye, his figure appeared in front of a dilapidated house. As he expected, the first flash went very smoothly, as if everything was under control.
Ye Heng stretched out his hand to wipe away the large beads of sweat on his forehead, his breathing was a little rapid. The extreme flash just now almost exhausted most of his martial power, but he did not stop. He crossed his legs, sat on the floor, closed his eyes and entered a meditative state.
In meditation, he carefully recalled what he saw and heard along the way. He clearly remembered that there were no complex terrains such as slopes within 30 kilometers of the surrounding area. This gave him confidence, and his next plan gradually became clear.
When the meditation ended, Ye Heng opened his eyes, with a determined light shining in his eyes. He decided to cancel the Martial God Battle Armor and used Ultimate Flash twice again. As long as you can successfully leave Longzhao City, things will become much easier later on.
He stood up, adjusted his breath, and prepared to face the next round of challenges. He knew that these two extreme flashes would be the key and an important step in whether he could get out of the predicament.
He took a deep breath, and after silently cheering himself up in his mind, he activated the blink again. He clearly remembered that there were no complex terrains such as slopes on the way here, even 100 kilometers away in a straight line, so after meditating this time, he could cancel the Martial God Battle Armor and perform blink. Then after this blink and another meditation blink, he could completely leave Shenlong City. After leaving Shenlong City, everything would be easy to say, but... is that true?
After seven extreme flashes, Ye Heng's body was on the verge of collapse, and he felt as if he was about to be torn apart. In this series of teleportations, he first traveled through Shenlong City and then came to Dragon Claw City. And this Longzhao City is famous for its many mountains. Ye Heng blinked three times before he successfully left this city.
However, once you cross Longzhao City, the rest of the journey is relatively easy. Because the following Dragon Belly City, like Shenlong City, is an endless plain area.
However, Ye Heng, who was now in Longfu City, felt a panic. It turns out that Longfu City is the urban area with the largest diameter and largest area in Longguo, with an area of 1.66 million square kilometers! Facing such a huge astronomical urban area, Ye Heng couldn't help butBreaking into a cold sweat.
Even if he tried his best and could perform 20 consecutive extreme flashes in one breath, he could not escape from this huge city. His heart was filled with despair, and he didn't know how to get out of this vast land.
Ye Heng secretly thought in his heart: "If I can escape into the gate of the void, I can return to the Kingdom of Martial God in an instant." However, he immediately realized that escaping into the void is the unique skill of the SS Martial God. With his own A-level Martial God's strength, this is undoubtedly a fantasy.
"It seems that it will be difficult to escape from this Dragon Belly City in less than ten days..." Just when Ye Heng felt at a loss and almost fainted, Ai Xi and Ai Xi suddenly jumped out of the Miaoyu Pot.
Ai hoped that looking at the pale Ye Heng in front of him, his heart was filled with endless love and care. Without any hesitation, she immediately mobilized her powerful martial arts power and poured it into Ye Heng's body continuously. At the same time, she shouted anxiously: "You must hold on! You must not die!"
Ye Heng smiled slightly and tried to reassure Ai Xi: "Don't worry, I won't die. I'm just a little weak. I can recover after two hours of rest."
Amy frowned and said worriedly: "But it looks like the situation is not optimistic. The powerful enemy we encountered this time is too powerful, and we may not be able to escape."
Ye Heng took a deep breath, and a trace of determination flashed in his eyes: "Well, if this is the case, then we must face it bravely."
Amy nodded and agreed: "Okay, then I will send our location and related information to the headquarters now."
She took out her communicator and quickly edited a message: "The appearance of the artifact has attracted strong men from all sides to compete for it. Although we fought hard to win it, we were ultimately unable to do so and were seriously injured. We are here to recuperate. I hope the headquarters will send help quickly." As her finger touched the send button, this key message flew into the distance.
(Headquarters...)
The sky in Wushen Kingdom gradually became gloomy and dark, thick dark clouds covered the sky, and heavy rain of soybeans fell one after another.
Lisa stood quietly, looking into the distance. That place was where Ye Heng was currently - Dragon Kingdom.
"Now that the artifact is coming to the world, the world may fall into chaos again. Although the five countries have formed a united front on the surface to fight against the supernatural beasts, in fact everyone has their own hidden agendas and intrigues. If one party can obtain the artifact, it will be like having an invincible weapon of war. It will not be afraid of half-color when fighting the supernatural beasts, and at the same time it can stabilize the status and strength of its own country."
"Just like King Kai, who is an SSS-level Martial God. He is already very powerful. In addition, he controls the trajectory of the sacred weapon Sora. He once competed with the Five Kingdoms on his own, and in the end he was no less powerful."
"And that battle made him even more famous, and he eventually ascended to the throne of one of the five most powerful people in the world, and was also revered as the Mad King."
